newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech April CPI up 6.7 pct yr/yr, 0.6 pct mo/mo.
newsitem.headline: Czech April CPI up 6.7 pct yr/yr, 0.6 pct mo/mo.

text.p: Czech consumer prices rose 0.6 percent in April putting year-on-year inflation at 6.7 percent versus 6.8 percent in March, the Czech Statistical Burea said on Monday.
CZECH CONSUMER INFLATION April 97 March 97 April 96
APRIL CPI BASKET COMPONENTS CHANGE MO/MO CHANGE YR/YR

Note. March basket component changes in brackets. All changes are rises except where stated. Prices have risen 24.9 percent from the average level for 1994 while the sliding average in March using a 1993 base was 8.2 percent. Basket of goods and services is unchanged from 1995.
The CSU said in a statement that core inflation in April accounted for +0.424 percent of total inflation, while the influence of price deregulation was +0.201 percent.
